item.title: Scientists in South Africa have named a new dinosaur whose young already weighed about 400 kg
item.description: A groundbreaking discovery in South Africa has unveiled a new dinosaur species named Nyana rooiwalensis. This juvenile, weighing approximately 400 kilograms at just three years old, shows signs of rapid growth through bone analysis. Nyana is categorized among sauropodomorphs, the ancestors of the gigantic dinosaurs we know today. This finding provides vital insights into the evolutionary journey and growth dynamics of early dinosaurs. Fuente: The Times of India - World.
